summary.text: Bradley Lacko, also known as Brad, is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 53 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Matt Lundy.
He has run for the Ohio House before, losing to Rep. Joe Miller in 2020 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Bradley Lacko advanced from the Republican primary for District 53 on May 5, 2026, in an uncontested race.
He was the Republican candidate for Ohio House District 56 in 2020, when incumbent Joe Miller defeated him in the general election.
Lacko ran again in District 53 in 2024, and Miller again won the general election.
He has not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2020, 2024 or 2026.
